headline: One photo, 3 different works
reasons: The same photo file (fingerprint 42dcc3d6e72d) is attached to 3 different works in 3 villages. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 3 separate works.
The works are recorded as: Other (2), Bore-Well Recharge (1).
The entries were made by 2 different offices: Canal Patwari/Ropar Canal & Ground Water Division, XEN/ BML Patiala.
These works are spread over 3 blocks: Dehlon, Maloud, Samrala.
